uso: Ilustrações-fonte, seguidas de recorte, redução e empacotamento técnico na grade do jogo.

atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art atlas for a Stardew Valley 1.6 Content Patcher farming mod, Vale das Araucárias.
Make a single SQUARE 1024 x 1024 sprite sheet on REAL TRANSPARENCY. It is an exact invisible grid of 8 equal columns and 4 equal rows. Each cell is 128 x 256 pixels, representing a native 16 x 32 pixel sprite enlarged precisely 8x. Every colored logical pixel should be an aligned 8 x 8 square. NO smooth edges, NO gradients, NO background, NO ground tiles, NO cast shadows, NO grid lines, NO text/labels, NO border, NO logo. Pure crisp native-style Stardew Valley pixel art, small readable silhouettes, limited warm vibrant palettes, dark brown/green outlines, three shade clusters, top-left highlights, charming hand-placed chunky pixels, almost identical density and proportion to original Stardew crops. Design for reading at 16x32, NOT detailed illustrations.
Each row is one plant from left to right: column 1 planted seed (very small at bottom), column 2 seedling, column 3 juvenile, column 4 larger growing, column 5 pre-harvest, column 6 fully ripe mature, column 7 inventory seed packet, column 8 harvested crop inventory icon.
All PLANT sprites col 1..6 are perfectly centered horizontally in their cell and share a ground baseline y=240 within that row, leaving 16 transparent pixels below, with no soil patch. Grow progressively in height and foliage. Use maximum width 112 pixels (14 logical pixels), never overlap adjacent cells. Plants remain shorter than 240 pixels. Inventory seed packets and harvest icons are each at most 112 x 112 pixels and sit in the bottom 128 x 128 square of their cell, centered there. Seed packets are cream paper with a colored top fold and small crop symbol, no letters. Do not put background checkerboards in the pixels. Exactly 32 isolated sprites arranged 8 by 4.
ROW SUBJECTS:
Row 1 (top, y=0..255): Feijão-preto, Brazilian bush BLACK BEAN, NO trellis. Leafy bush with trifoliate oval green leaves. Pre-harvest small pale-purple flowers and slender pods. Mature bush has tan dry pods and some dark bean hints. Inventory black beans are 3 glossy BLACK kidney-shaped beans with subtle pale hilum, not green beans; seed packet has black-bean symbol.
Row 2 (y=256..511): Mandioca / cassava. Grows from short brown planted stem cutting, then reddish thin stalk with palmate deeply lobed narrow leaves. Large mature plant has three distinctive star-shaped leaf clusters. No fruit. Harvest is TWO tapered brown bark roots, one with an ivory white cut end. Seed packet bears a cassava-root icon.
Row 3 (y=512..767): Batata-doce / sweet potato. Low creeping purple-tinted green heart-shaped foliage, no tall stalk or trellis. Mature root crown shows a hint of pink-purple tubers. Harvest is a pair of elongated pink-purple sweet potatoes, one showing warm cream interior; seed packet purple accent.
Row 4 (bottom, y=768..1023): Cebola / yellow onion. Thin tubular green upright leaves become a clear golden-brown onion bulb above soil with wilted tips when mature. Not garlic, not leek. Harvest is one warm golden onion with two short green tips and papery root tuft; seed packet ochre accent.

Row 1 (top, y=0..255): Maracujá / yellow passion fruit climbing vine ON WOODEN TRELLIS. Same wooden trellis is present in ALL first six plant cells even first planted seed. Trellis 3 short rungs, 2 posts, brown, max logical 13x28. Vine progressively covers trellis with lobed green leaves, preharvest pale lilac flowers, fully ripe 2 GOLDEN ROUND PASSION FRUITS. At preharvest trellis is full foliage without ripe fruit (also serves as regrowth frame). Harvest inventory icon one round golden passion fruit and a half showing seeded yellow pulp; seed packet gold-purple accent.
Row 2 (y=256..511): Pimentão / red bell pepper bush, NOT chili, NO trellis. Oval green leaves, branched small bush, preharvest fully leafy with tiny white flowers and no red fruit (regrowth frame), mature with two squat bright RED bell peppers. Harvest one distinct glossy lobed red bell pepper with green top; seed packet red accent.
Row 3 (y=512..767): Aveia-branca / white oats. Grass sprouting then open loose drooping panicles, unlike dense wheat spikes. Mature pale golden, 3 delicate dangling cream seed clusters above green stems. Harvest a small bound bundle of three oat stalks with drooping white-gold panicles; seed packet cream/green accent.
Row 4 (bottom, y=768..1023): Cevada / barley. Thin green grass growth ending in dense golden plump spikes with LONG upward awns. Ripe golden and orange. Harvest small three-stem bunch of golden barley with pronounced bristles; seed packet orange-gold accent.

Row 2 (y=256..511): Soja / soybean. No trellis. Small bush has distinctive broad trifoliate light-green leaves; preharvest tiny lavender flower dots; mature rounded bush has tan fuzzy grouped short pods. Harvest 4 round light GOLDEN-YELLOW SOYBEANS with tiny brown hilum, not black beans or green pods; seed packet yellow accent.
Row 3 (y=512..767): Azevém / annual ryegrass forage. Low dense fresh-green clump progressing to vibrant erect green grass blades and slim tiny seed spikes. Mature remains GREEN for forage, NOT dry golden wheat. Harvest green cut forage bundle tied in the middle; seed packet dark-green accent.
Row 4 (bottom, y=768..1023): Arroz irrigado / paddy rice. Thin bright green shoots become tufts with drooping curved gold rice panicles above green leaves. No water background or muddy soil, transparency must remain. Ripe rice has 3 nodding panicles with golden grains. Harvest icon small bunch of rice panicles and a few tan unhusked grains, not a cooked rice bowl; seed packet blue-green accent.

extras:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production food inventory sprite atlas for Vale das Araucárias, a Stardew Valley 1.6 farming mod.
Create one SQUARE 1024x1024 image with REAL TRANSPARENT background, arranged as a precise 2x2 grid, one isolated sprite per quadrant.
Each object should be designed as a genuinely tiny 16x16 pixel Stardew Valley inventory icon and enlarged with NEAREST NEIGHBOR to fit its quadrant, NO smooth rendering. Use at most 12 colors per sprite, clear 1-pixel dark warm outline, simple chunky pixel clusters, top-left warm highlights, solid opaque pixels, absolutely no gradients or anti-aliased edges. Native Stardew look: lovely rustic food icons, clearly recognizable at 16x16, not high-resolution concept art. Nothing overlaps quadrants. No text, label, watermark, grid, shadows, ground, backdrop, or painted checkerboard.
Top left quadrant: FARINHA DE MILHO / FUBÁ: an open cream cloth flour sack full of warm yellow golden cornmeal, ochre folded rim, a tiny yellow corn cob symbol on the front with green husk. Cornmeal clearly yellow, NOT white flour.
Top right: AVEIA EM FLOCOS: a small squat cream paper sack with a pale teal-blue folded upper rim, visible cream oat flakes in its open top, a simple oat sprig symbol.
Bottom left: BROA DE MILHO: one round rustic golden-yellow corn bread, domed top with 3 simple cracked crust lines, dark golden underside, no plate. 
Bottom right: BOLO DE FUBÁ: one small warm golden ring-shaped Brazilian cornmeal bundt cake with central hole and a single separated wedge displaying bright yellow crumb, no icing, no candles, no plate.
Occupy only the central 75 percent of each quadrant, giving an even transparent margin on all sides. Four icons total.
